172: def names_match(pattern: str, name: str) -> bool:
173:     """
174:     Case-insensitive match of a name against a pattern which may contain the
175:     multi-character wildcard "*", mirroring the ILIKE matching of the database.
176: 
177:     :param str pattern: e.g. "John*"
178:     :param str name: e.g. "Johnson, Jane"
179:     :rtype: bool
180:     """
181:     regex = re.escape(pattern).replace(r'\*', '.*')
182:     return bool(re.fullmatch(regex, name, flags=re.IGNORECASE))

200: def get_author_records(query: dict) -> list[dict]:
201:     """
202:     Runs an author query against Open Library, following redirects, and
203:     returns the matching author records ordered by their numeric OL key.
204: 
205:     :param dict query: e.g. {"type": "/type/author", "name~": "Smith*"}
206:     :rtype: list
207:     :return: List of OL author records
208:     """
209:     visited: set[str] = set()
210:     resolved: set[str] = set()
211:     authors = []
212:     for key in list(web.ctx.site.things(query)):
213:         if key in visited:
214:             continue
215:         visited.add(key)
216:         obj = web.ctx.site.get(key)
217:         # FIXME should have no limit
218:         while obj is not None and obj['type']['key'] == '/type/redirect':
219:             assert obj['location'] != obj['key']
220:             obj = web.ctx.site.get(obj['location'])
221:         if (
222:             obj is None
223:             or obj['key'] in resolved
224:             or obj['type']['key'] != '/type/author'
225:         ):
226:             continue
227:         resolved.add(obj['key'])
228:         authors.append(obj)
229:     return sorted(authors, key=key_int)
